versions.content: It is possible to set the Ethernet State Manager in a dummy mode (see chapter 10 configuration specification). In this mode, the Ethernet State Manager doesn’t support the API to the Ethernet interface. The API to the ComM is available but the functionality is deactivated. The function calls from the ComM will be answered with the return value E_OK.
